dataco.attribution: Constante, Silva, Pereira (2019), DataCo Smart Supply Chain for Big Data Analysis
dataco.caveat: actual days are almost uniform within a mode, so the publisher's data may itself be simulated; used only to draw delivery-history rows
dataco.selection: first row of each order, cancelled shipments excluded

m5.selection: frozen 500 forecast series; test weeks d_1886..d_1941; every day sold at least one unit and the daily mean is within [4, 40]; first and last such week per series; 40 same-department items nearest by item number
